title: Vas Halidani
note: Bohdan's interior of Mnehmos's descent + address. He counts each step as the UNCATEGORIZED FORCE bleeds off the brass through his palm (0.58 UNITS → 0). His name lands third; he answers 'Jsem zde.' in Czech; the bridge translates as 'Here.' The word 'Vas Halidani' confirms his palm's structural read: chamber-above-cistern. He rises when the slab offers no objection. The floor holds by more than reputation now; it holds by name.

events.observed: Mnehmos begins descent; first step bears ~90kg evenly set; brass flashes warmer then lets go

events.returned: BEARING 103% NOMINAL · RESIDUAL THERMAL 14 K ABOVE STONE · UNCATEGORIZED FORCE: 0.58 UNITS

events.observed: Step 2-6: charge runs off Mnehmos down the brass line past Bohdan's spread fingers; nails reseat in limestone; air pressure equalizes against eardrums; copper taste at back of throat
Step 7: Mnehmos reaches floor proper; echo of boots two heartbeats late; brass no longer shines with anything but torch-light

events.returned: BRASS NAIL-LINE · CURRENT BEARING: NOMINAL · UNCATEGORIZED FORCE DISCHARGED
events.bohdan_observation: The slab releases its hold on his palm. Masonry has gone honest again.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Cole Maddox. Renata Salk. Bohdan Cerny. Yuki Aritomo. Wren Adebayo.
events.bohdan_reaction: Name lands third — 'weight of a tamped stone on fresh bed.'

events.note: First spoken word in this world. Czech bled through; the bridge translated. Mnehmos's mouth shifted slightly — Bohdan could not tell whether at the Czech or the cadence.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: I am Mnehmos. I performed the rite that brought you here.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: You are in Sebastopyr. This chamber is in the Cathedral Sebastinum, above the Vas Halidani that holds the Grace I spent to bring you. The city beyond it is real. So are its risks.
events.bohdan_reaction: The word 'Vas Halidani' confirms what his palm already knew — hollow cylinder ~40 cubits deep, ringed with radiating galleries. 'Legal title just changed hands from rumor to record.'

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: The understanding that lets our speech meet is provisional. It will hold until the third day at evening.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Cerny will rise when he chooses; do not approach the slab he is reading.
events.bohdan_reaction: The command frees a thin murmur among the attendants, quickly stilled.

events.note: Right knee straightens first; left follows when slab offers no objection. Brass dust print left in his palm's whorls.

events.returned: LANGUAGE BRIDGE: PROVISIONAL · expires PD 606 · DAY 3 · 18:00
Vas Halidani sub-floor: substantial reserve drawn but not empty; hydrostatic pulse minimal post-discharge; cathedral vault stress transmits clean — no imminent failure

ledger_state_at_chapter_end.engine_withholding: What 'Grace' is in mechanical terms — refused. Why Mnehmos selected — refused.
